import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int globalN, globalT;
    static String[] firstGrid, secondGrid;
    static int[][] distFromZ = new int[30][30];
    static int[][] distToZ = new int[30][30];
    static final int[] dirX = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dirY = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static class MyEdge {
        int from, to, cap, flow;
        MyEdge(int f, int t, int c) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static List<MyEdge> edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] adjList = new List[2005];
    static int[] levels = new int[2005];
    static int[] currentPos = new int[2005];

    static boolean inBoard(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < globalN && y >= 0 && y < globalN;
    }

    static void firstBfs(int startX, int startY) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; ++j)
                distFromZ[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{startX, startY});
        distFromZ[startX][startY] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dirX[d], ny = y + dirY[d];
                if (inBoard(nx, ny) && distFromZ[nx][ny] == Integer.MAX_VALUE && secondGrid[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                    distFromZ[nx][ny] = distFromZ[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void secondBfs(int startX, int startY) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; ++j)
                distToZ[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{startX, startY});
        distToZ[startX][startY] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            if (distToZ[x][y] >= distFromZ[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dirX[d], ny = y + dirY[d];
                if (inBoard(nx, ny) && distToZ[nx][ny] == Integer.MAX_VALUE && firstGrid[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && distToZ[x][y] + 1 <= distFromZ[nx][ny]) {
                    distToZ[nx][ny] = distToZ[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean buildLevelGraph() {
        Arrays.fill(levels, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(0);
        levels[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && levels[globalN * globalN * 2 + 1] == -1) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int eid : adjList[u]) {
                MyEdge e = edgeList.get(eid);
                if (levels[e.to] == -1 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                    levels[e.to] = levels[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return levels[globalN * globalN * 2 + 1] != -1;
    }

    static int pushFlow(int node, int bottleneck) {
        if (bottleneck == 0 || node == globalN * globalN * 2 + 1) return bottleneck;
        for (int i = currentPos[node]; i < adjList[node].size(); ++i) {
            currentPos[node] = i;
            int eid = adjList[node].get(i);
            MyEdge e = edgeList.get(eid);
            if (levels[e.to] != levels[node] + 1) continue;
            int sent = pushFlow(e.to, Math.min(bottleneck, e.cap - e.flow));
            if (sent > 0) {
                e.flow += sent;
                edgeList.get(eid ^ 1).flow -= sent;
                return sent;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int computeMaxFlow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (buildLevelGraph()) {
            Arrays.fill(currentPos, 0);
            while (true) {
                int sent = pushFlow(0, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                if (sent == 0) break;
                total += sent;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        globalN = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        globalT = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        firstGrid = new String[globalN];
        secondGrid = new String[globalN];
        for (int i = 0; i < globalN; ++i) firstGrid[i] = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < globalN; ++i) secondGrid[i] = br.readLine();

        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < globalN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < globalN; ++j) {
                if (secondGrid[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    firstGrid[i] = firstGrid[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + firstGrid[i].substring(j + 1);
                    secondGrid[i] = secondGrid[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + secondGrid[i].substring(j + 1);
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        firstBfs(zx, zy);

        int totalNodes = 2 * globalN * globalN + 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < totalNodes; ++i) adjList[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        edgeList.clear();

        for (int i = 0; i < globalN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < globalN; ++j) {
                if (firstGrid[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int u = i * globalN + j + 1;
                int v = globalN * globalN + u;
                int val1 = firstGrid[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                int val2 = secondGrid[i].charAt(j) - '0';

                edgeList.add(new MyEdge(0, u, val1));
                adjList[0].add(edgeList.size() - 1);
                edgeList.add(new MyEdge(u, 0, 0));
                adjList[u].add(edgeList.size() - 1);

                edgeList.add(new MyEdge(v, totalNodes - 1, val2));
                adjList[v].add(edgeList.size() - 1);
                edgeList.add(new MyEdge(totalNodes - 1, v, 0));
                adjList[totalNodes - 1].add(edgeList.size() - 1);

                secondBfs(i, j);
                for (int x = 0; x < globalN; ++x) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < globalN; ++y) {
                        if (secondGrid[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || distToZ[x][y] > globalT) continue;
                        int w = globalN * globalN + x * globalN + y + 1;
                        edgeList.add(new MyEdge(u, w, val1));
                        adjList[u].add(edgeList.size() - 1);
                        edgeList.add(new MyEdge(w, u, 0));
                        adjList[w].add(edgeList.size() - 1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(computeMaxFlow());
    }
}
